newsitem.title: MEXICO: One Mexican crude shipping port closed for fog.
newsitem.headline: One Mexican crude shipping port closed for fog.

text.p: Mexican crude shipping port Pajaritos was closed at 0650 local/1450 GMT Wednesday because of dense fog, a port authority official told Reuters.
Officials at Mexico's two other main crude ports in the Gulf of Mexico, namely Dos Bocas and Cayo Arcas, said the terminals remained open to shipping in light winds.
A cold front in the Gulf of Mexico sent rains and winds along the coast Tuesday and closed Frontera port in Veracruz state.

Pajaritos is under the authority of Coatzacoalcos port in Veracruz and ships an average 400,000 barrels per day, according to the latest statistics from state owned oil and gas monopoly Petroleos Mexicanos (Pemex).
